summary: Workspace navigation/member edge swipes use a narrow Android system-gesture exclusion aligned to the full-window decor view, while Android Back remains available outside the declared region.

checks.name: Android and iOS workspace edge swipe widget coverage
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart test/horizontal_swipe_region_test.dart
checks.observation: Edge-starting left navigation and right members gestures pass on iOS and Android widget configurations; app gesture guards still reject unrelated start zones and vertical drags.

checks.name: Native Android gesture exclusion bridge coverage
checks.observation: The bridge enables only requested edges, updates when drawer eligibility changes, clears on disposal, and does not claim edge gestures on iOS.

checks.name: Full-window system gesture exclusion alignment
checks.observation: Exclusion rectangles are now applied in decorView coordinates so inset content bounds cannot leave the physical display edge uncovered. The Android 200 dp vertical cap remains in place.

checks.name: Android debug APK build
checks.observation: Flutter and native Android Kotlin sources compiled successfully.

checks.name: Physical Android Back/edge gesture acceptance
checks.command: adb shell settings get secure navigation_mode; adb shell input swipe 1 1200 520 1200 300; adb shell input swipe 1078 1200 560 1200; adb shell input swipe 0 200 500 200 400; adb shell input swipe 1078 200 580 200 400
checks.observation: Pixel 7 reports gesture-navigation mode 2 at 1080x2400. A left-edge swipe at vertical center opened the channel drawer and did not invoke Back; a right-edge swipe at vertical center opened the members drawer. Left- and right-edge swipes at y=200 px, outside the centered 200 dp drawer-exclusion zone, invoked Android Back and returned to the prior ChatGPT activity. The app was restored after each Back check; workspace data and messages were not changed.

remaining: Android physical edge/Back acceptance is complete. iOS swipe behavior and the remaining unified mobile drawer/dock gesture flows are tracked in QA-78 and QA-79.
